name: fx_party3_field
doc: Stands in for saves/battle_re/party3_field.state/.lakewram (the suite's three-member party in the field): from the Diablos fight in the Cathedral's inner hall (fx_bat9) A is mashed (8 frames held of every 20, 115 times) until the fight is won, then 300 frames: the field resumes in loc 082 with Crono, Lucca and Frog, control back ($011F = 01) -- the capture's own recipe (its regress_inputs entry). Crono 26/96 and Lucca 39/88 at level 3, Frog 120/128, 1105 G, the bag Pendant + Heal (the capture: 25, 40, 128).
